events.title: ‘The clock is ticking’: Hashmi talks with Hampton Roads residents about Dominion Energy merger
events.summary: Lt. Gov. Ghazala Hashmi held a listening tour in Hampton Roads, gathering concerns from residents about the proposed $67 billion merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy. Residents expressed worries over potential bill increases, grid reliability, and job losses, particularly given NextEra's track record in Florida. While Hashmi has not taken a stance, she emphasized that the merger's approval by the Virginia State Corporation Commission should hinge on its proven benefits for Virginians, especially regarding affordability and service.

articles.headline: ‘The clock is ticking’: Hashmi talks with Hampton Roads residents about Dominion Energy merger

events.title: SC utility buyout cleared by Dominion and NextEra shareholders
events.summary: Shareholders of Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy have approved a $67 billion deal to combine the utilities, with NextEra as the owner, clearing an early hurdle for what would become the world's largest regulated power utility by stock market value. The all-stock deal, announced on May 18, faces scrutiny from consumer groups and politicians but is expected to close in the second half of next year if approved by state and federal agencies. The acquisition aims to address growing power demands, especially from data centers, and promises a $2.25 billion billing credit for Dominion's South Carolina ratepayers over two years.

articles.headline: SC utility buyout cleared by Dominion and NextEra shareholders

events.title: Quantum Stocks Fall as Rate-Hike Odds Climb: IonQ Sinks 4%, Rigetti and D-Wave Pull Back
events.summary: Quantum computing stocks, including IonQ, Rigetti, and D-Wave, experienced a sharp decline as increasing odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike made speculative growth stocks less attractive. This market movement is attributed to the expectation of higher interest rates, which increases discount rates for future cash flows, particularly impacting pre-revenue companies. Despite broader market stability, quantum pure plays saw significant drops, highlighting their sensitivity to changes in monetary policy.

articles.headline: Quantum Stocks Fall as Rate-Hike Odds Climb: IonQ Sinks 4%, Rigetti and D-Wave Pull Back

events.title: Data center community advocacy groups seek local public hearings on Dominion-NextEra merger
events.summary: A coalition of nine Virginia community advocacy groups, including Protect Stafford and Safeguard Spotsy, is advocating for increased transparency and public participation in the review of the proposed $67 billion Dominion Energy-NextEra Energy merger. They are requesting in-person regional public hearings across Dominion's service territory and a reconsideration of the statutory timeframe for the State Corporation Commission's decision, which they deem inadequate for such a complex transaction. Delegate Joshua Cole also opposes the merger, citing concerns about monopoly creation and the ability to meet energy demands for data centers, and suggests state lawmakers could address the issue in a current special session.

articles.headline: Data center community advocacy groups seek local public hearings on Dominion-NextEra merger

events.title: AI is fueling copper demand. Kevin Simpson thinks this volatile miner is worth the risk
events.summary: Kevin Simpson has added Freeport McMoRan Inc. to his dividend income portfolio, viewing it as a calculated risk given copper's strong long-term supply-demand story, driven by AI and data center needs. Despite the stock's volatility and recent price run-up, he believes the valuation becomes more attractive when considering 2027 earnings projections, and the company offers direct exposure to rising copper demand and limited new supply. Key catalysts include recovering production from the Grasberg mine and the significant leverage Freeport provides to higher copper prices.

articles.headline: AI is fueling copper demand. Kevin Simpson thinks this volatile miner is worth the risk

events.title: Is Earnings Beat Altering The Investment Case For Texas Instruments Stock (TXN)?
events.summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) has seen strong recent earnings and revenue beats, supporting its investment case tied to resilient industrial and automotive chip demand. The company is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity, and current financial strength helps absorb depreciation, though analysts anticipate ongoing execution tests. Despite positive forecasts and a projected 25% upside to its fair value, the long-term investment narrative remains centered on careful management of capacity and competitive pressures.

articles.headline: Is Earnings Beat Altering The Investment Case For Texas Instruments Stock (TXN)?

events.title: CASCADE INVESTMENT LLC's Recent Buy: Acquires $164.70M In Republic Services Stock
events.summary: CASCADE INVESTMENT LLC, a 10% owner of Republic Services (NYSE: RSG), recently purchased 735,303 shares for $164.70 million, signaling confidence in the company. Republic Services, the second-largest waste management company, reported a 4.6% revenue growth, a 42.14% gross margin, and an EPS of 1.84, though it has a higher debt-to-equity ratio and its P/S ratio indicates potential overvaluation. This insider transaction highlights a belief in the stock's future rise, despite mixed financial metrics.

articles.headline: CASCADE INVESTMENT LLC's Recent Buy: Acquires $164.70M In Republic Services Stock

events.title: Las Vegas Sands stock hits 52-week low at $43.35
events.summary: Las Vegas Sands Corporation (LVS) stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $43.35, marking a 38% decrease from its high and a 31% year-to-date decline. Despite strong gross profit margins and a low PEG ratio suggesting undervaluation, the company recently missed second-quarter earnings expectations, leading to analyst downgrades and reduced price targets from Argus, Mizuho, and Stifel, citing economic challenges in China and a slow recovery in Singapore.

articles.headline: Las Vegas Sands stock hits 52-week low at $43.35

events.title: Valero Energy Corporation stock hits all-time high at 385.11 USD
events.summary: Valero Energy Corporation's stock has hit an all-time high of $385.11, currently trading at $386.82, and showing a 141.55% increase over the past year. This significant surge follows impressive second-quarter results, with adjusted earnings and revenue surpassing Wall Street estimates, and strong performance in refining, renewable diesel, and ethanol sectors. Analyst ratings from UBS and TD Cowen reflect continued confidence, with UBS raising its price target to $450.

articles.headline: Valero Energy Corporation stock hits all-time high at 385.11 USD

events.title: Fifth Third-Comerica merger leaves some customers angry over glitches
events.summary: The merger between Fifth Third Bancorp and Comerica Bank has resulted in significant online banking glitches and customer frustration following its technical conversion. Despite assurances of a smooth transition, many customers, including Robert Erlandson and David Boike, reported being unable to access accounts, encountering issues with bill payment data migration, and facing long wait times for support. Fifth Third acknowledged the challenges, stating it was the "largest and most complex undertaking" for both companies and apologized for the inconvenience, promising full engagement from their teams to assist customers.

articles.headline: Fifth Third-Comerica merger leaves some customers angry over glitches

events.title: Helios Technologies' Enovation Controls Acquires Radio Sound Assets
events.summary: Helios Technologies' subsidiary, Enovation Controls, has acquired the assets of Radio Sound. This acquisition expands Helios Technologies' offerings, particularly in the Electronics segment, which designs and manufactures customized electronic control systems. The company's stock, HLIO, was trading at $71.53, up 0.15% at the time of the article.

articles.headline: Helios Technologies' Enovation Controls Acquires Radio Sound Assets

events.title: Chevron stock hits all-time high at 214.85 USD By Investing.com
events.summary: Chevron's stock has reached an all-time high of $214.85 USD, currently trading at $215.17, giving the company a market capitalization of $417 billion. The stock has seen a 35.64% increase over the past year and 41.5% year-to-date, reflecting strong financial health and investor confidence. InvestingPro analysis suggests Chevron is undervalued and highlights its consistent dividend increases for 38 consecutive years.

articles.headline: Chevron stock hits all-time high at 214.85 USD By Investing.com

events.title: Conocophillips stock hits 52-week high at 137.57 USD
events.summary: Conocophillips (COP) stock reached a 52-week high of $137.57, reflecting a robust 45.27% increase over the past year and a 51.64% total return. This performance is attributed to favorable market conditions and strong operational execution, with analysts suggesting the stock remains undervalued despite recent gains. The company also reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, exceeding analyst estimates, and announced strategic initiatives like a revised price target from UBS and an acquisition by Aker BP involving ConocoPhillips Skandinavia assets.

articles.headline: Conocophillips stock hits 52-week high at 137.57 USD

events.title: ExxonMobil at Barclays energy-power conference: growth through disruption
events.summary: ExxonMobil CFO Neil Hansen highlighted the company's scale, technology, and project discipline as key to navigating volatile energy markets at the Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference. Hansen detailed how ExxonMobil is leveraging its integrated model, strong balance sheet, and long-term investment strategy to drive growth and shareholder value, pointing to successful Pioneer acquisition synergies and accelerated Guyana cost recovery. The company also emphasized its focus on new growth areas like LNG, advanced resins, and graphite battery materials, alongside continued frontier exploration, projecting significant earnings and cash flow growth through 2030 and beyond.

articles.headline: ExxonMobil at Barclays energy-power conference: growth through disruption

events.title: Booking loses Etraveli acquisition appeal
events.summary: European lawmakers have denied Booking Holdings' appeal regarding its acquisition of Etraveli Group, upholding the European Commission's decision that the deal would boost Booking's dominant position and increase barriers to entry. The online travel giant initially announced the €1.6 billion acquisition in late 2021, but the EC barred it three years ago, leading to Booking's unsuccessful appeal. Booking Holdings stated disagreement with the outcome and is considering an appeal to the European Court of Justice.

articles.headline: Booking loses Etraveli acquisition appeal

events.title: BRP Inc. (TSX:DOO) Drops 6.47% as Tariff Risks, Margin Pressure and Profit-Taking Weigh on Momentum
events.summary: BRP Inc. (TSX:DOO) shares fell 6.47% on September 8th despite a positive quarterly update, indicating profit-taking, valuation reassessment, and concerns over tariffs and inflation. The company's business model relies on powersports and marine product sales, but its discretionary nature makes it susceptible to economic uncertainties. Key risks include trade policy, consumer cyclicality, competitive pressures, and geopolitical instability.

articles.headline: BRP Inc. (TSX:DOO) Drops 6.47% as Tariff Risks, Margin Pressure and Profit-Taking Weigh on Momentum

events.title: Independence Realty Trust and Centerspace Agree to $8.1 Billion Merger
events.summary: Independence Realty Trust and Centerspace have agreed to an $8.1 billion merger, including debt, to form a large middle-market apartment real-estate investment trust. This deal will combine Independence Realty's multifamily properties in the Sunbelt with Centerspace's portfolio in the Midwest and Mountain West.

articles.headline: Independence Realty Trust and Centerspace Agree to $8.1 Billion Merger
Independence Realty Trust merges with Centerspace in $8bn deal

events.title: NewEdge Advisors LLC Acquires 9,282 Shares of The Boeing Company $BA
events.summary: NewEdge Advisors LLC increased its stake in The Boeing Company by 2.8% during the second quarter, acquiring an additional 9,282 shares, bringing their total holdings to 340,198 shares valued at $73.6 million. Despite Boeing reporting an 8% year-over-year revenue increase to $24.56 billion, its adjusted loss of $0.76 per share missed analyst expectations. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for Boeing with an average price target of $272.58, significantly higher than its reported price of $210.80, and institutional investors own 64.82% of the shares.

articles.headline: NewEdge Advisors LLC Acquires 9,282 Shares of The Boeing Company $BA

events.title: Waverly Advisors LLC Acquires 48,638 Shares of Cincinnati Financial Corporation $CINF
events.summary: Waverly Advisors LLC significantly increased its stake in Cincinnati Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:CINF) by 56.9% in the second quarter, acquiring 48,638 additional shares, bringing its total holdings to 134,084 shares valued at $24.8 million. This move is part of broader institutional investor activity, with major firms like Goldman Sachs also modifying their positions. Cincinnati Financial recently reported quarterly EPS of $1.43, missing analyst estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.94 per share, while analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $195.40.

articles.headline: Waverly Advisors LLC Acquires 48,638 Shares of Cincinnati Financial Corporation $CINF

events.title: ServiceNow Sharpens Its Salesforce Attack With Sweep Acquisition
events.summary: ServiceNow has acquired Sweep, an Israel-based software company specializing in agentic AI capabilities for enterprise systems. This acquisition is aimed at bolstering ServiceNow's burgeoning CRM push against Salesforce, by enhancing its ability to build AI agents and accelerate enterprise application deployments. The move underscores ServiceNow's strategy to expand its AI-based NOW platform into the CRM market, where it has seen significant growth in its CRM business.

articles.headline: ServiceNow Sharpens Its Salesforce Attack With Sweep Acquisition
